verdict.rationale: Dots runs as an always-on cloud agent that keeps working while the user's computer is off and can follow recurring scheduled instructions. Those are adjacent autonomy features, not a documented headless or CI invocation mode. The runtime probe found no dots-specific public API, CLI, or MCP surface, so a pipeline cannot programmatically drive it. Delegating to Codex cloud tasks is a different product's capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: your dot lives in the cloud and has its own computer and browser. You can reach it and it can keep working even when your computer is off.
